question: How should Telegram callback source chat/message metadata be exposed to agents and current-message/tool context without replacing callback query identity?
rationale: Current source proves the metadata is missing, but the field shape and propagation boundary affect agent prompt text, MessageSid semantics, current-message helpers, and Telegram callback dedupe.

options.title: Add explicit callback metadata
options.body: Expose source chat/message ids as separate callback metadata while leaving callback query id for dedupe and answerCallbackQuery behavior.

options.title: Reuse MessageSid
options.body: Use the Telegram source message id as MessageSid for callbacks, accepting a semantic change to callback dedupe/session identity.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Leave generic callback turns with only callback_data and require plugins/native callbacks for source-message edits.

recommendation.title: Add explicit callback metadata
recommendation.body: Expose source chat/message ids as separate callback metadata while leaving callback query id for dedupe and answerCallbackQuery behavior.
